name: 1601 Indiana Avenue — Brick dwelling (district draft; refined by T-1946)

grade.why: Known from maps or written records; no picture of it has been found.

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: Robinson 1886 draws the row and T-3068 carries its corner to 1904 because the ice-cream works reached the corner only after the scene. When the corner houses came down is not read.

placement.position_note: The rear corner of the main body's rectangle (lot frame u 0.750, v -6.180 m from the middle of the rear lot line), through the T-1250 fit of the plate: the plate's fit is 4.54 m RMS, the weakest of the four T-1250 fits (a photographed atlas page, rotated and curved toward the binding), plus about a pixel (0.35 m) of reading. Rotation 179.529 degrees turns the plan's u axis onto the lot's own rear-to-street line.
placement.symbolic_location: 1601 S. Indiana Avenue, parcel indiana_1601 (data/street_grid/1904.json), east side of Indiana Avenue, the background behind Prairie Avenue: Indiana Avenue's east frontage, 16th to 18th Street, and East Sixteenth Street's row at 209-217 (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 20, checked lot by lot against Robinson 1886 plate 10).

footprint.note: The main body: the largest rectangle that fits inside the traced main part (u toward the street, v along the front). The building's other rectangles are in draft_plan.

stories.note: RECONSTRUCTED: Robinson's atlas prints no storey count, and the 1911 sheet, which would, no longer draws the row. Three storeys is the block face's own median: the 1911 sheet prints 3B, 3B, 2½B, 2B and 3½B on the Indiana and 16th Street houses drafted beside it.

construction.note: Robinson 1886 colours the building pink, the plate's brick (its frame buildings are yellow).

parts.from: r1886-1601-f p1 (main, brick), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 97% of its fill

draft_plan.note: Rectangles fitted inside the traced parts by the rules' fit (cell 0.25 m, at most 3 a part, to 90% cover): r1886-1601-f p1 (main, brick), rectangle 1 of that part; the part's rectangles cover 97% of its fill. Roles: the main part's largest rectangle is the main body; a shallow rectangle at the front is a bay; the sheet's ranges, porches and stone fronts keep their roles. Storeys per piece and roof per piece are the draft rules' (reconstructed).

draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row '(default)' overlaid with the frontage row: The west end of the 1886 brick row on 16th Street, at the Indiana corner: the brick family's hip over three storeys, until T-1946 parts it into its houses. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 3342707308 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %. Liberty L-draft-indiana-1904-lots-3068.

draft.note: The draft's own provenance: the pass that wrote it, the rows it read and the tickets that replace it attribute by attribute under this id.

function.note: The 1911 sheet draws the ice-cream works' five-storey office and tin shop at 1601-1603. The T-3019 census, as T-3068 rules it (frontage-20w-1601–1603, backcast_1886), stands the corner of the 1886 brick row for 1904, because the corner was not in the ground the ice-cream firms bought in September 1903 and is first in their hands in December 1906. Residence is inferred from the row's 1886 form; no household at the corner is in the 1902 directory or the 1904 Blue Book.

citations.citation: Robinson, E. Robinson's Atlas of the City of Chicago. New York: E. Robinson, 1886. Plate 10, "Part of 2.39.14 Assessors Div."
what_it_supplies: The water's edge beside the Illinois Central from above 16th Street to 18th, as of 1886 -- a bound, from before, on the 1904 edge
Lot and subdivision lines, and the outlines of the houses at 1609-1611 and 1620 Prairie that Glessner House names as standing in 1904 and gone by 1911
what_it_does_not_supply: Street widths: its bands are not drawn to the widths it prints (Prairie printed 66, drawn about 55 ft)
Anything as of 1904 on its own authority

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-3068, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1946 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the Robinson 1886 plate 10 reading (r1886-1601-f: the outline in the plate's pixels, carried by its T-1250 fit) (r1886-1601-f), the T-3019 census (r1886-1601-f) and the T-1837 register row frontage-20w-1601–1603 (Brick dwelling); every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-indiana-1904-lots-3068).
